text:
sam: Heads-up: leadership wants a small GTM experiment for 'Growth Starter'—targeting startups onboarding via partner flows. Need quick alignment on packages + a small low-latency add-on.

sam: Draft proposal: Starter = 10M tokens/mo, 30k embeddings, 2 routes, 30s latency SLO best-effort. Add-on 'Fastlane' = per-endpoint priority lanes, billed as $X per 1000 priority-minutes.

neha: Quick Q: do we use token quotas + per-route QPS? customers will ask about burst behaviour.

sam: Plan: baseline quota, and a separate Fastlane quota measured in priority-minutes. Bursts allowed within base quota only. Fastlane only affects scheduling priority, not guaranteed capacity.

ryan-design: UX idea: in checkout show two toggles: "Enable Fastlane (pay as you go)" + "Enable temporary onboarding burst (30 days)". Keep wording simple.

mike-ops: Ops note: implementing priority lanes requires adding a routing tag and billing tag. Routing tag exists but tagging for metering is missing. Estimated 4 dev-days to wire end->end and add tests.

ivy-legal: Legal concerns: we must avoid implying an SLA for Fastlane. Also need explicit opt-in for priority billing. I'll prepare a short consent clause.

billing-bot: Reminder: billing pipeline supports increments by tokens and by custom metric. We'll need a new metric "priority_minutes" emitted from router. Confirm format: metric name + customer_id + minutes.

neha: Launch gating: 1) metric emitted and visible in billing pipeline for sample partner, 2) checkout copy approved, 3) docs + pricing calculator, 4) legal opt-in text live.

sam: Also require telemetry: per-customer 7d avg cost-per-token and per-priority-minute; alarm if >20% off forecast for first 2 pilots.

ryan-design: I'll mock checkout wording and send for review by Tue AM.

mike-ops: I'll spin up a routing-test harness to emit priority_minutes and wire the billing tag. ETA Thu. Will include simple script: 

```
# test emit
emit_metric("priority_minutes", customer="c-abc", value=5)
```

billing-bot: Good. Once emitted, pipeline will create a preview invoice in 24-48h for validation.

ivy-legal: Draft opt-in: "I understand Fastlane is a best-effort scheduling priority and not a performance SLA. I consent to usage-based billing for priority minutes." Will post PR.

neha: Pricing ask: what is the baseline rate? Sam, propose a number range so we can validate elasticity.

sam: Suggest $0.20 per priority-minute (range $0.10-$0.30). We can pilot at $0.15 to reduce sticker shock.

mike-ops: Ops cost calc: priority-minutes map to CPU/GPU interference; rough cost ~ $0.03/min. Sam's range looks workable. Need to ensure unit economics.

ryan-design: Checkout copy draft sent. Minimal: "Starter: 10M tokens/mo. Fastlane: pay-as-you-go priority minutes for lower latency." Link to modal with details.

billing-bot: To validate: provide a sample customer_id and we'll run a test invoice. Also need ingestion latency <90s for the metric.

sam: Owners: mike-ops = routing + metric (ETA Thu), billing-bot (billing) = validate preview invoice (ETA Fri), ryan-design = checkout (Tue AM), ivy-legal = opt-in copy (Wed).

neha: If any gating fails, fallback: ship Starter without Fastlane, and run Fastlane as a private opt-in pilot later.

sam: Agree. Let's treat Fastlane as an opt-in beta for first 2 partners. Aim to have gating-checklist by EOD Friday.

mike-ops: Started work, will post PR link + test harness by Wed.

ivy-legal: PR for opt-in copy posted. Please review.

billing-bot: Test invoice created for partner c-pilot1 after metric emission. Please verify amounts.

sam: Verified invoice for pilot1. Numbers look sane.

neha: Moving forward unless someone flags an issue. Thanks all :rocket:
